svg.title: Sorting experts by use
svg.desc: Animation: the 40 x 384 grid of expert use starts in stored order, scattered, then each layer's experts slide into sorted order, leaving a dark band of busy experts on the left of every layer, mostly inside the 12% the cards have room for.

g.text: A few experts do most of the work, in every layer
share of each layer's decode tokens per expert, 64 BIRD training questions
